title: 2025: A year of resilience and resourcefulness
content:
by Joanna Clarke, on behalf of the PLOS Biology Staff Editors

2025 was marked by upheaval and uncertainty for many within the life science community. As we reflect on the year that has gone, we highlight some of the many research achievements that give us reasons to be thankful. 2025 was marked by upheaval and uncertainty for many within the life science community. In this Editorial, we reflect on the past year and highlight some of the many research achievements that give us reasons to be thankful.
author: Joanna Clarke
